max_turns exhaustion → HarnessBudgetExhausted + Waiting(UserInput) + attention; partial evidence retained
SIGKILL mid model stream → restart suspends the run with attention → StartTask resumes under the lease, transcript rebuilt from the log (3 tool results), exactly one change.apply ever
steer queued before start reaches the first model request as a tagged user message with a durable TaskSteered
cancel during a stalled stream → StepCancelled, TurnInterrupted, RunCancelled, TaskCancelled
no-progress detection (3 turns) → Waiting with attention (observed while diagnosing the broker replay bug)
found and fixed: broker idempotency keys ignored the tool call id so identical commands replayed an older process; transport timeouts were misclassified as retryable connect failures
